name: Generated promos
description: Renders promos from your own templates (text, artwork, music and voice-over) for the shows actually coming up. Install voice plugins for the voice-overs.
author: SchedularrTV

settings.label: Save folder
settings.description: Where rendered promo videos and voice-overs are kept. ErsatzTV must be able to read it. Leave empty for state/generated-promos in the data folder. Changing it doesn't move existing files: copy the old folder across to keep cached voice-overs, so paid voices aren't asked for them again.

settings.label: Start rendering when a promo airs within (minutes)
settings.description: 0 renders the whole playout ahead. Promos further out wait, so a rebuild or edit before then doesn't leave renders behind that never air. Allow time for the queue to finish: a slot whose promo isn't ready airs ordinary commercials of the same length.

settings.label: Only render for channels someone is watching
settings.description: Uses ErsatzTV's stream activity, so paid voices are only spent on channels with a viewer. Other channels air stand-in commercials in each promo slot. Tuning in starts rendering within about 30 seconds, so the first few slots may still be stand-ins.

settings.label: Keep unused videos for (days)
settings.description: 0 keeps them forever. Videos a schedule still uses are never removed.

settings.label: Keep voice-overs for (days)
settings.description: 0 keeps them forever. Counted from when a voice-over was last used, so lines that keep airing stay cached; paid voices are only asked again after one has gone unused this long.
